description_en: Queries the zones of a region in which a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance is deployed
description_zh: 查询NLB一个地域下的可用区列表
kebab_example: aliyun nlb describe-zones --service-code nlb --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accept-language zh-CN --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeZones

parameters.help_en: The service code. Set the value to nlb
parameters.name: service_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the zone belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 可用区所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The supported natural language. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese
en-US (default): English
ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
支持的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文
en-US（默认）：英文
ja：日文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate this value. Ensure that the value is unique among all requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not specify this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.**** RequestId of each request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
